component.name: ProbeScene
component.script: sub init() uris = ["", "font:MediumSystemFont", "font:MediumBoldSystemFont", "font:SmallSystemFont"] sizes = [18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 38, 40, 42, 45, 48, 50, 55, 60] texts = ["Roku Emulator fidelity probe", "Unable to connect.", "WWWWW", "iiiii"] for each uri in uris for each size in sizes font = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Font") if uri <> "" then font.uri = uri font.size = size line = "uri=" + uri + " size=" + size.toStr() for each text in texts label = m.top.CreateChild("Label") label.font = font label.text = text bounds = label.boundingRect() line = line + " | " + bounds.width.toStr() + "x" + bounds.height.toStr() m.top.removeChild(label) end for print line end for end for ' Size assigned before the uri, and fonts declared in XML. for each size in [20, 34, 50] font = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Font") font.size = size font.uri = "font:MediumSystemFont" label = m.top.CreateChild("Label") label.font = font label.text = texts[0] bounds = label.boundingRect() print "size-first size=" + size.toStr() + " | " + bounds.width.toStr() + "x" + bounds.height.toStr() m.top.removeChild(label) end for for each id in ["xmlSystem", "xmlEmpty", "xmlDefault"] label = m.top.findNode(id) bounds = label.boundingRect() print id + " uri=" + label.font.uri + " size=" + label.font.size.toStr() + " | " + bounds.width.toStr() + "x" + bounds.height.toStr() end for print "@@PROBE_END" end sub
